Hi Carlos / OliveTech procurement team —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your inference workload. We're starting procurement onboarding for OliveTech and want to get vendor master data aligned so POs and payments flow cleanly once your contract and SOW are final. A few immediate asks to unblock Finance and Procurement: 

1) Confirm the primary remit address we should use on POs (you listed two addresses in the portal; which is active?).
2) Provide an updated banking statement or bank letter with the account name/IBAN/SWIFT if you want bank changes applied.
3) Can you confirm your DUNS / Tax ID? Our supplier portal shows two supplier records that look like duplicates — we'd like to merge them but will follow your direction.

I've attached our standard vendor form (REDWOOD_VENDOR_FORM.pdf) which collects the info Finance needs. If you can return that plus a W-9 (or country equivalent) we'll kick off the master-data updates.

Proposed next steps (targeting completion by EOD Thu):
- OliveTech returns form + W-9 and bank evidence
- Redwood opens master-data change request and validates (procurement + finance)
- If duplicate supplier detected, we confirm which record to keep and update POs accordingly

I'll loop in Karthik (procurement) and Marcus (finance ops) to manage the change. 

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Accounts (Americas)
Redwood Inference
